desc.profilePicture: Choose the image shown on your profile.
desc.displayName: Choose how your name appears in the workspace.
desc.email: Manage the address used to sign in.
desc.dateOfBirth: Add a birthday for a personal greeting.
desc.twoFA: Require an authenticator code when signing in.

enable2FA.title: Set up an authenticator
enable2FA.description: Add this QR code to your authenticator, then continue to verify a code.
enable2FA.confirmationDescription: Enter the current code from the authenticator you just connected.

disable2FA.title: Remove the authenticator requirement
disable2FA.description: Future sign-ins will no longer require an authenticator code. Continue?

twoFA.disableFailed: Two-factor authentication could not be disabled.
twoFA.setupFailed: The setup code could not be loaded.
twoFA.verifyFailed: The code was not accepted. Try the current code from your authenticator.

oauth.changeAlert: The new client ID and secret replace the saved values. Keep your own backup if you need the old credentials.
oauth.keepBlank: Leave a field blank to keep its saved value. A supplied value replaces it, and saving enables this provider.
oauth.saveFailed: The provider could not be updated.
oauth.removeDescription: Remove this provider’s saved credentials and sign-in option?

messages.avatarFailed: The profile picture could not be saved.

validation.credentialChange: Enter a new client ID or secret.
validation.otp: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator.
